title: Silent config break: empty default ipfs.api_url breaks existing configs
description: IpfsConfig::default_api_url was changed from 'http://127.0.0.1:5001' to '' to support the new validation rule requiring explicit [ipfs] or [backend]. Any operator config that omitted [ipfs] (previously silently defaulted to Kubo at 5001) now fails validation with 'either [backend] or [ipfs] with a non-empty api_url is required'. No migration note or changelog entry was added. When operators upgrade and their daemon refuses to start, the error message is clear but the cause (a default changed under them) is not. Fix: add a CHANGES entry or comment in config.rs explaining the intentional break and what operators must add.
